title: GCM encrypt: oversized-tag check fires after ciphertext written to out_buf
description: Encrypt path: authTagSz > CRYPTO2DEV_TAG_MAXLEN (16) is checked AFTER write/FINALIZE/read (crypto2dev_port.c:860). Decrypt path checks the same condition BEFORE pool acquire (line 774). Asymmetry: encrypt with authTagSz=17 acquires pool slot, sends INIT/IV/AAD/write/FINALIZE, reads ciphertext into out_buf, then returns BUFFER_E. Ciphertext without an authentication tag is left in the caller's output buffer. A caller that ignores the return code (or buffers output before checking) holds unauthenticated ciphertext with no signal that the tag was never retrieved. Fix: move the authTagSz > TAG_MAXLEN check before pool acquire on the encrypt path, symmetric with the decrypt path.
